paragraphs: CRIMEWATCH runs public-facing portals and a communications platform for police agencies. The platform is built for law enforcement and is described as CJIS-ready. Residents use it to find a local public safety portal, where agency updates and active warrants from across the network are posted.

The suite has four parts. A workflow product gives an agency one workspace to draft, route, approve and publish to web, mobile and social with a clear chain of command and audit history. Approval routing is configurable so an officer drafts, a supervisor reviews and a public information officer or command approves. A collaboration layer lets agencies, task forces and regional partners share intelligence and coordinate in real time. An AI assistant turns incident details into public messaging, with drafts still routed through review and approval.

The public side spans responsive portals, a unified national mobile app and TV kiosks, described as ADA compliant and multilingual. Information moves both ways, with anonymous tips linked to specific content, online reporting, camera and special-needs registries and vacation checks. The company says the community platform connects more than 360 agencies. Pricing is based on the population an agency serves.

quote.text: Solved cases start with a tip. Tips start with trust.
